detail.longDescription:
I sometimes get contacted by people (?) I don't know.

There are times when I suspect some aren't human — but, instead are some type of (LLM-based) AI agent.

I ask them to do a video call.

At least currently, the AI agents tend to ignore my request to do a video call.

Although, I know that even today it is easy to create AI based video. Even interactive video.

So, AI agent "reluctance" to do a video call probably won't last long.

#AgenticComputing #AI #AIAgent #AIAgents
